lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a spec requires a security property of an algorithm constant time compare csprng source assert the property itself not just the boolean result a result only test passes an early exit rewrite unchanged
lessons.text: When a spec requires a security property of an algorithm (constant-time compare, CSPRNG source), assert the property itself, not just the boolean result — a result-only test passes an early-exit rewrite unchanged.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::testing a pure header policy builder does not cover the wiring that decides when to apply it assert the composed response from the middleware for each conditional branch sensitive vs non sensitive path
lessons.text: Testing a pure header/policy builder does not cover the wiring that decides when to apply it; assert the composed response from the middleware for each conditional branch (sensitive vs non-sensitive path).

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::every cookie the app sets needs its attributes samesite secure path max age asserted on the emitted set cookie header not just its value attribute downgrades are silent and security relevant
lessons.text: Every cookie the app sets needs its attributes (SameSite, Secure, Path, Max-Age) asserted on the emitted Set-Cookie header, not just its value — attribute downgrades are silent and security-relevant.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::a guard that collapses distinct denial reasons into one null return cannot honour per reason redirect targets return a discriminated result when the spec names different destinations for different failures
lessons.text: A guard that collapses distinct denial reasons into one null return cannot honour per-reason redirect targets; return a discriminated result when the spec names different destinations for different failures.

lessons.key: ac_gap::never list a requirement id in a describe test label unless that block actually asserts it a mislabelled block reads as coverage during review and hides a zero evidence ac
lessons.text: Never list a requirement ID in a describe/test label unless that block actually asserts it — a mislabelled block reads as coverage during review and hides a zero-evidence AC.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a dev mode relaxation of a security control adding unsafe eval under isdev contradicts an unconditional shall not record it as an explicit spec exception rather than encoding it silently in a branch
lessons.text: A dev-mode relaxation of a security control (adding 'unsafe-eval' under isDev) contradicts an unconditional SHALL NOT; record it as an explicit spec exception rather than encoding it silently in a branch.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::extracting a branch into a testable pure module only covers the decision not the call site assert the consuming wiring too or the mapping from decision to effect redirect target header status can be flipped with every test still green
lessons.text: Extracting a branch into a testable pure module only covers the decision, not the call site — assert the consuming wiring too, or the mapping from decision to effect (redirect target, header, status) can be flipped with every test still green.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a shared error response helper needs every call site covered not just the ones the spec names an uncovered branch can be rewritten to leak a distinguishing message while the helper s own tests stay green
lessons.text: A shared error-response helper needs every call site covered, not just the ones the spec names — an uncovered branch can be rewritten to leak a distinguishing message while the helper's own tests stay green.
